title: Scarlett's Beach Heaven | KEY.co
description_expanded: Every home is well equipped with linens on each bed, as well as an extra set for any sleeper sofas that may be in the home. Each bathroom is stocked appropriately with bath towels, hand towels, wash cloths, and bath mats to accommodate the sleeping capacity of the home. There are starter sets of soap, detergent, dish soap, and toilet paper there for your convenience. Kitchens are each stocked with enough dishes, serving pieces, glassware, and all the other kitchen necessities to prepare meals during the guests stay. We provide a starter set of laundry detergent for our guests to use when they arrive. Just steps from the sugar-white sands of Miramar Beach, this pet-friendly retreat redefines coastal elegance with ten spacious bedrooms, nine and a half bathrooms, and every amenity imaginable for a seamless group getaway. With a private pool, rooftop observation deck, and in-home elevator, it effortlessly blends comfort and style across three beautifully designed levels. Whether you're cooking in the chef-inspired kitchen, cruising the neighborhood on the included golf cart, or sipping cocktails while the sun sets over the Gulf, this home makes vacationing feel effortless and extraordinary.
